Draft a 3-step reconciliation plan: locate March bank statement + GL cash export, build a matched-ledger sheet, then verify the ending balance ties.
Plan accepted; two source documents are expected in the room's attachments.
STEP 1 · TOOL · TOOL: FINDDOCUMENT · $0.00 · 1180MS
Call findDocument to locate the March bank statement and the GL cash export in the room attachments.
Found 'bank-statement-march.pdf' and 'gl-cash-march.csv'; both attached to room RC-MAR-RECON-8271.
STEP 2 · WRITE · TOOL: WRITESHEET · $0.00 · 2960MS
Write reconciliation.xlsx: import both sources, match cleared items by amount+date, list unmatched items on an exceptions tab.
Sheet created with 84 matched rows and 2 exceptions; ending-cash formula wired to the reconciliation tab.
STEP 3 · VERIFY · $0.00 · 900MS
Verify reconciled ending cash equals the bank statement ending balance and re-open the exported sheet.
Reopen OK, but ending cash is off by 412.50 — one exception (check #1042) is unsourced; flagged for review rather than forced to tie.
